name: dsh-whale-maid
description: The 1024Store whale girl as a DSH desktop pet: the full twelve-state sprite animation (blink, joy, eat, play, welcome, drag-tilt, think, work, sad, sleep, wake, wander) ported from the plugin-market site, with drag-to-move, click-to-greet, feed and play actions, plus a settings section — and since 1.1.0 a companion layer: work-status poses, mood/affection/satiety, daily quests, check-in, 41 achievements, tap zones and proactive care.
author: lov0vo
